++def run_shell(command: str, cwd: str | None = None, timeout: int = 20):
++    """Execute a non-interactive shell command inside the runtime root.
++
++    Safety:
++    - CWD is constrained to ROOT or a subpath under ROOT.
++    - Blocks a small set of obviously dangerous commands (sudo, apt, systemctl, shutdown, reboot).
++    - Time-limited, captures stdout/stderr.
++    """
++    if not isinstance(command, str) or not command.strip():
++        return {"ok": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": "empty command", "code": 1}
++
++    blocked = ["sudo", "apt ", "apt-get", "systemctl", "service ", "shutdown", "reboot"]
++    low = command.lower()
++    if any(b in low for b in blocked):
++        return {"ok": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": "command blocked by policy", "code": 126}
++
++    cwd_path = ROOT
++    if cwd:
++        try:
++            target, _ = safe_rel_path(cwd)
++            cwd_path = target
++        except Exception as e:
++            return {"ok": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": f"invalid cwd: {e}", "code": 2}
++
++    try:
++        proc = subprocess.run(
++            ["bash", "-lc", command],
++            cwd=str(cwd_path),
++            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
++            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
++            text=True,
++            timeout=timeout,
++        )
++    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
++        return {"ok": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": "timeout", "code": 124}
++    except Exception as e:
++        return {"ok": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": str(e), "code": 1}
++
++    # Bound output size to keep responses reasonable
++    def tail(s: str, n: int = 200000):
++        if not s:
++            return ""
++        return s[-n:]
++
++    return {
++        "ok": proc.returncode == 0,
++        "stdout": tail(proc.stdout),
++        "stderr": tail(proc.stderr),
++        "code": proc.returncode,
++        "cwd": str(cwd_path.relative_to(ROOT)) if cwd_path != ROOT else "",
++    }
++
